seoTitle: Collier County School Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Collier County Public Schools 2025-2026 calendar with Aug 11 first day, May 29 last day, Fall Break, Spring Break, early dismissal, PDF and ICS.
calendarNotes: Collier County Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year for students on Monday, August 11, 2025 and ends the student year on Friday, May 29, 2026 with early dismissal. Teachers start August 4 and the last teacher day is June 1. Fall Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2 with students returning January 6 after a January 5 teacher plan day, and Spring Break runs March 9-13. The official calendar totals 180 student days and 196 teacher days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Collier County school start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day for Collier County Public Schools is Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Collier County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Friday, May 29, 2026. It is also listed as an early dismissal day and the end of Quarter 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Collier County Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 9 through Friday, March 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Collier County Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, November 24 through Friday, November 28, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Collier students return after Winter Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return to school on Tuesday, January 6, 2026. January 5 is a teacher plan day with no school for students.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student and teacher days are in the Collier 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar totals 180 student days and 196 teacher days.
